player_prompt.intro:
Wee Player {player_id} mu Nimi.
Lengo lako ni kuchukula chinthu chilichose.
Pa kila turn, chagua ngolo imodzi ikulu na uchuke zinthu zing'onozing'one kuchokazo.
Tumia fomu '[pile quantity]', ambapo ngolo ndi ile ya ngolo na quantity ndi nambari ya zinthu zochukuliwa.
Kwa mfano, '[0 3]' ichukula zinthu 3 kuchoka ngolo 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Palibe mtundu wovomerezeka wa kusuntha womwe wapezeka. Gwiritsani ntchito '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Mndandanda wa ma piles {pile_index} uli kunja kwa malo.

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.
